title: The change skipped spec deltas although it changes a Docker image and adds a test, not only docs
resolution: Removed skip_specs and added the native-worker-acceptance requirement that the Linux test image of the crash-window and G2 suites provides the worker's pinned Git client; the delta validates strictly and archives cleanly in a scratch copy.

title: The Git pin agreement test matched literal text, so a commented-out check passed and extra spaces failed
resolution: The test reads the instructions of the worker stage and the test image's last stage, without comment lines and with continuations and whitespace normalized. Of its seven new cases, four failed against the old matching and all pass now.

title: The Ubuntu 24.04 dependency row said the test image build adds no package, although it now installs git, and the record claimed no doc changes
resolution: The row states that the test-only image of make verify-linux-cgroup installs the pinned git=1:2.43.0-1ubuntu7.4 since this change; proposal.md lists the row and verification.md drops the no-doc-changes claim.

title: design.md cited infra/installation/Dockerfile:58-67 for the Git install, which starts at line 61 and ends at line 69
resolution: Cites infra/installation/Dockerfile:61-69; every other line citation of the change was checked and resolves.

title: The requirement said the Linux Git client pin is installed, but a pin is a version string that git --version prints
resolution: The build fails unless the package is installed and /usr/bin/git --version prints the Linux Git client pin, git version 2.43.0.

title: The apt layer of the Git client sat after the Node.js layers, so every Node.js pin bump re-downloaded git
resolution: ARG GIT_PACKAGE_VERSION and its RUN come before ARG NODE_VERSION; make verify-linux-crash-windows and make verify-linux-g2-scenarios pass on the fixed tree.
